# Home

A small corpus that exercises the layouts WeasyPrint is known to regress on:
grid cards, admonitions, tabbed content and code blocks longer than a page.

!!! note

    The pages that follow carry unique sentinel strings. If WeasyPrint
    truncates the document, those sentinels disappear from the PDF.

## Getting started

1. Read the [Long Code](long-code.md) page.
2. Continue to the [Sections](sections.md) page.
3. Finish on the [Grids and Admonitions](grids.md) page.
